segments.title: 第50章 賺點小錢
segments.content:
Reigniting the Verdant Years Chapter 50: Making a Little Money

At first, Li Luo didn't pay much mind to the matter.

The school hadn't said that the military training uniforms would definitely come with a belt.

Besides, the pants of these military training uniforms had an elastic waistband. For the average person, they basically wouldn't fall down during normal walking, though they might slip during exercise.

It was just that Ying Chanxi was rather slim, especially with her willowy waist, so the military training pants looked loose and baggy as soon as she put them on.

After just a few steps, it felt like her pants were slipping down. Although they would get caught on her hips and not slide all the way off, this was bordering on a suggestive way to wear them.

If her movements were any larger during military training, they would definitely fall off.

"There's no belt?" Li Luo looked puzzled, specifically opening his own set of training uniforms. He then pulled out a belt. "Isn't there one right here?"

"Not this one," Ying Chanxi shook her head, went back into the bedroom, and returned with a belt in her hand, which she buckled around her waist. "See, this one is so thick, it's meant to tighten the jacket. It can't even fit through the belt loops on the pants."

Li Luo paused for a moment, then looked down to study it and found that it was indeed the case. "They probably just didn't include a belt."

With that thought, Li Luo took out his phone and walked towards Xu Youyu's bedroom.

He first called Zhao Rongjun, urging him to quickly open his military training uniform and check if there was a belt.

After confirming this, Li Luo knocked on Xu Youyu's door and asked about last year's military training situation.

"Oh, I think there wasn't a belt for the pants." Xu Youyu poked his head out. After hearing Li Luo's question, he scratched his head and recalled, "But there's a clothing store right across from the school. A lot of students went there to buy belts back then. You guys can go take a look tomorrow too."

"Is that so..." Li Luo nodded, indicating he understood.

If he were an ordinary high school student, he would probably just wait until tomorrow and buy a belt from that clothing store.

But Li Luo thought of something else. He took out his phone again and called his uncle, Lin Xiufeng.

"Hello? Xiao Luo?" Lin Xiufeng was a bit surprised, not expecting a call from Li Luo at this hour. "What's up?"

"Uncle," Li Luo thought for a moment, then said, "I remember that Third Grandpa's family sells clothes, right? My cousin-uncle is in charge?"

"That's right." Lin Xiufeng was a little curious why he was asking this, but he still nodded and said, "I work at your cousin-uncle's company. We transport a lot of clothes."

"I see." Li Luo raised his eyebrows and then smiled. "Do you have any belts then? Not the expensive kind, just the really cheap ones that can last for a few days or half a month without breaking."

"We should," Lin Xiufeng recalled. "I remember there's some stock in the warehouse, but I'll have to ask. Why are you asking about this?"

"I have a little business opportunity here." Li Luo cleared his throat twice, then said, "It depends on whether you're interested, Uncle."

...

August 25th, Monday morning.

The lady boss of the Yimei Clothing Store unusually didn't open her shop at eight in the morning. Instead, she opened early at six and specifically hung various kinds of belts on a rack by the entrance.

Every year, when Fuyi High School and Qianjiang University started their school year, it was the lady boss's harvest season.

On Zhenxing West Road, their store was the closest clothing store to these two schools.

And one of the lady boss's relatives was a director in the logistics department of Qianjiang University. In the annual procurement of military training uniforms, they would deliberately not purchase belts for the students' pants.

And the procurement department of Fuyi High School always placed their orders together with Qianjiang University every year.

As a result, every year around this time, students would have to find a way to buy belts.

After all, the average student wouldn't usually buy a belt to keep on hand, so the lady boss of the Yimei Clothing Store could make a small fortune of tens of thousands of kuai from this every year.

The canteens in Qianjiang University's dormitory area mostly sourced their belts from her.

As for Fuyi High School, there was only one small supermarket at the bottom of the dormitory building that opened after school let out in the evening. Plus, the supermarket owner had some connections within the school, so the clothing store owner didn't try to make any arrangements, simply opening her doors early and waiting for the students to come to her.

Fuyi High School's campus and dormitory buildings were separate.

Only the third-year students' dormitory was located inside the campus.

The first and second-year students' dormitory was in the dormitory area across the road from the school gate. They had to enter and exit the school gate and cross the road to get to and from school.

Under these circumstances, coming out of the dormitory building, if they wanted to buy a belt, they just needed to turn left and walk a few steps to reach the entrance of the Yimei Clothing Store.

After moving the belts to the entrance early in the morning, the lady boss moved a stool and sat there, quietly waiting for her lovely prey to walk right in.

The belts on the side were divided into three tiers: 15 kuai, 25 kuai, and 40 kuai, but their wholesale cost was only one or two kuai each.

There were over six hundred students in a single grade at Fuyi High School, with only a hundred or so being day students. As long as more than half of them bought her belts, the lady boss could earn at least several thousand kuai.

But just as she was thinking this, a truck slowly drove to a spot between her clothing store and the gate of the dormitory area.

Because of how it was parked, the front of the truck was facing the clothing store, while the rear cargo doors were directly facing the exit of the dormitory area gate.

Lin Xiufeng hopped down from the driver's seat, walked to the back of the truck, and opened the cargo doors.

The lady boss glanced at the truck but didn't pay it much mind.

She was sitting just inside her store entrance, with the fan blowing from above. From her slanted view, she could just see the front of the truck, but from that angle, she couldn't see what was happening at the back.

And so, from six in the morning until six-thirty, almost no students came to her store to buy belts.

At first, the lady boss didn't think much of it, assuming that the students were excited about their first day in the dorms, stayed up late yesterday, and were sleeping in today.

But when two students in military training uniforms came into the store and asked about the price of the belts, then immediately turned and left upon hearing that the cheapest one was 15 kuai, the lady boss was a bit stunned.

"What's the meaning of this?" the lady boss muttered. "If they don't buy from me, what else can they do?"

Thinking this, the lady boss followed them out of the store with a suspicious look on her face and glanced towards the dormitory area gate. Then she froze.

Behind the truck's cargo bed, a crowd of first-year high school freshmen in military training uniforms had gathered.

The lady boss walked closer for a look and discovered that the cargo bed was full of belts. The students were lining up, buying belts one by one for ten kuai each, which was a lot cheaper than what she was selling.

Seeing this, the lady boss's head spun, and she almost fainted from anger.

"Where are you from? Selling things right here? Is this even legal?" The lady boss couldn't contain her anger. She walked up and questioned Lin Xiufeng.

Suddenly being asked this, Lin Xiufeng was completely baffled. He then turned his head to look at Li Luo beside him.

Li Luo, also in a military training uniform, was squatting on the truck bed, happily selling belts. He glanced at the lady boss and asked back curiously:

"Auntie, you must be the owner of that clothing store next door, right?"

As he said this, Li Luo suddenly looked at the students around him and said earnestly, "Auntie is probably just a little anxious. After all, everyone's trying to make money. If any of you are in a hurry from waiting in line, you can go check out Auntie's store."

"What's there to see?" a student grumbled. "The cheapest belt at her place is 15 kuai, and the most expensive is 40. It's just military training, why buy such an expensive belt?"

As soon as he said this, the students in line who had been a little tempted all stopped in their tracks again.

The lady boss looked at the students who were no longer moving, her face flushing red with anger. But she couldn't find anything to say, and could only grit her teeth in the end, "I'll sell them for ten kuai too!"
